tracks.title: First Light
tracks.about: Morning, before anyone else is up. A pulse, an organ, then the whole band at once.

tracks.title: Common Ground
tracks.about: Two guitars that disagree for a while, and a piano that keeps them in the same room.

tracks.title: Many Hands
tracks.about: Brass and a synth lead trading the tune, with a sixteenth-note pulse under everyone.

tracks.title: Open Hand
tracks.about: Heavy and slow to anger. Metal hits on the off-beat, a choir above the noise.

tracks.title: Signal
tracks.about: A message tapped out again and again until somebody answers.

tracks.title: Cornerstone
tracks.about: The stone the builders rejected. A pipe organ and a choir under the loudest guitars on the record.

tracks.title: Works of Mercy
tracks.about: Feed, give drink, clothe, shelter, visit, bury. A piano keeps count; the strings do the work.

tracks.title: Freely Given
tracks.about: Freely you have received; freely give. The last track turns to the major key and keeps going.
